method: Full reads of six pinned Python files; Git/SHA256 validation. Loaded query.py with runpy and executed numeric-range and query-subset controls, without importing GUI package or launching Gtk.
findings: parse_generic_range only appends truthy converted values, dropping valid zero endpoints. count0-2 becomes singleton2 and exact0 becomes empty match list entry. Original helper control rejects0 and1 from intended inclusive range.

Query.issubset rejects numeric constraints on new query but ignores numeric constraints on old query. It declares text foobar a subset of foo size1 even though new query permits arbitrary sizes. Actual caller reuse impact requires unread tree/view code review.

Size parser accepts integer amounts and single-letter binary unit suffixes; date converter behavior depends on optional parsedatetime presence. Parsing invalid entries logs warnings rather than returning explicit invalid-query status.
CLI validates tagged/untagged/script existence, but added-location paths are not in validation list. Verbosity offset4 maps default to DEBUG while comment says INFO.

Package entry requires Gtk3/Gdk/GdkPixbuf/PangoCairo/GtkSource4 before run_gui; Polkit optional. i18n sets process locale with fallback translation. Version fallback invokes rmlint through Gio and parses stderr version text; no timeout or explicit exit-code validation in this helper.
limits: No GUI rendering, tree filtering integration or scanner runtime execution.
183/289 blobs reviewed; global whole-repository count remains150/500.
